title: DART Ka Dhakka: 7 Minute Ka Hisaab, 33 Kaise Ho Gaya?
description:
DART ke baad asteroid ka chakkar sirf 7 minute badalna tha. Nateeja 33 minute nikla. Ye video simple Hindi me samjhata hai ki dhakka kaise kaam karta hai, mudne ka hisaab kaise lagta hai, aur aage asteroid se bachne ke kaun se tareeke hain.

Is video me: Chelyabinsk aur Tunguska, 5 kilotan ki taqat, DART mission aur Dimorphos, kaale pattharon ko dhoondhna, 2024 YR4 aur Apophis, aur asteroid ko hataane ke chaar tareeke.
